title: Do Time-of-Use Prices Deliver Energy Savings at the Right Time?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Time-of-use (TOU) electricity prices are increasingly being adopted to reduce consumption during the higher marginal cost afternoon hours. There is ample evidence that TOU rates reduce average consumption during the peak price hours of the day, but it is unknown how these energy savings are distributed across days. Using a unique dataset from households with smart thermostats, we find that adopting TOU rates causes large decreases in peak period AC usage, resulting in energy savings that are concentrated on the hottest, highest demand days when the benefits of conservation are the greatest.
abstract_zh: 分时电价（TOU）正被越来越多地采用，以减少在边际成本较高的下午时段的用电量。大量证据表明，分时电价可降低一天中高峰电价时段的平均用电量，但这些节能量在各日之间如何分布尚不清楚。利用一个来自安装智能温控器家庭的独特数据集，我们发现，采用分时电价会使高峰时段的空调用量大幅下降，且节能量集中在最炎热、用电需求最高的日子，而正是在这些日子里节约用电的收益最大。

title: The Cost-Effectiveness of Urban Water Demand Management Programs
venue: Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management
abstract: During droughts, potable water agencies may need to increase supply or reduce demand. Water agencies have many options for water demand management (WDM), including low flow toilets, showerheads, faucet aerators, educational outreach, and more. Reduced water consumption may result in energy savings, both at the customer and utility level. In this study, we estimated household water, electricity, and natural gas and utility-wide energy savings using statistical modeling for four large water demand management programs implemented between 2014 and 2018 in California. These programs focused on single and multifamily retrofit programs. These retrospective analyses were performed using household-level data gathered from multiple water, electricity, and natural gas companies. We found detectable water savings in three of the four programs, no detectable electricity savings for any program, and detectable gas savings in only one program. The deemed estimates of water savings were generally inaccurate predictors of actual savings. All programs that reduced household water consumption also reduced system-wide electricity consumption. A benefit–cost analysis was performed for each program from the perspectives of three stakeholders: water utilities, households, and a regulatory authority responsible for greenhouse gas emissions (GHGs). Many of the program actions were not cost-effective for the participating utilities and households because of the low cost of water. For the WDM programs considered here cost-effective from the perspective of the water utilities, the opportunity cost of consuming an additional unit of water would have to exceed their observed variable production costs in 2020 by a factor of 3 to nearly 20, dependent on the utility. In settings with sufficiently severe drought conditions and impending water scarcity, it is certainly plausible to expect that the opportunity cost of water consumption could reach such levels. WDM is an effective method of reducing GHG emissions for programs that target hot water savings, and the cost of these programs was consistent with non–water-related programs that target GHG emission reductions.
abstract_zh: 干旱期间，供水机构可能需要增加供给或减少需求。供水机构有许多水需求管理（WDM）选项，包括低流量马桶、淋浴喷头、水龙头曝气器、宣传教育等。减少用水量可能带来能源节约，既体现在用户层面，也体现在公用事业层面。本研究利用统计建模，估计了2014年至2018年间在加利福尼亚州实施的四项大型水需求管理项目所带来的家庭用水、用电、用气节约，以及公用事业层面的整体能源节约。这些项目主要针对单户和多户住宅的改造。回顾性分析使用的是来自多家水务、电力和天然气公司的家庭层面数据。我们发现，四个项目中有三个存在可检测的节水效果；所有项目均未检测到节电效果；仅有一个项目存在可检测的节气效果。节水量的预估值通常不能准确预测实际节水量。所有减少家庭用水量的项目，也都减少了系统层面的用电量。我们从三类利益相关者的角度对每个项目进行了效益成本分析：供水公司、家庭，以及负责温室气体（GHG）排放管理的监管机构。由于水价低廉，许多项目措施对参与的公用事业公司和家庭而言并不具有成本效益。就本文考虑的水需求管理项目而言，若从供水公司的角度看具有成本效益，则额外消费一单位水的机会成本须超过其2020年观测到的可变生产成本的3至近20倍，具体倍数因公用事业公司而异。在干旱极为严重、水资源即将短缺的环境中，水资源消费的机会成本达到此类水平完全是合理的。对于以节约热水为目标的项目，水需求管理是减少温室气体排放的有效手段，且其成本与以减排温室气体为目标的非水相关项目基本一致。

title: Understanding the Inequality and Welfare Impacts of Carbon Tax Policies
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium lifecycle model to explore the welfare and inequality implications of different ways to return carbon tax revenue back to households. We find that the welfare maximizing rebate uses two thirds of carbon-tax revenue to reduce the distortionary tax on capital income while using the remaining one third to increase the progressivity of the labor-income tax. This recycling approach attains higher welfare and more equality than the lump-sum rebate approach preferred by policymakers as well as the approach originally prescribed by economists __ which called exclusively for reductions in distortionary taxes.
abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个一般均衡生命周期模型，以探讨将碳税收入返还家庭的不同方式对福利和不平等的影响。我们发现，使福利最大化的返还方式，是将三分之二的碳税收入用于降低对资本收入的扭曲性税收，其余三分之一用于提高劳动所得税的累进性。这种循环利用方式比政策制定者青睐的一次性总额返还方式，以及经济学家最初提出的仅用于削减扭曲性税收的方案，都能实现更高的福利和更高的平等程度。

title: Building Codes Do Save Energy: Evidence from Hourly Smart-Meter Data
abstract: In 1978, California adopted building codes designed to reduce the energy used for temperature control. Using a rich data set of hourly electricity consumption for 158,112 houses in Sacramento, we estimate that the average house built just after 1978 uses 8% to 13% less electricity for cooling than a similar house built just before 1978. Comparing the estimated savings to the policy's projected cost, our results suggest the policy passes a cost-benefit test. In settings where market failures prevent energy costs from being completely passed through to home prices, building codes can serve as a cost- effective tool for improving energy efficiency.
abstract_zh: 1978年，加利福尼亚州通过了旨在降低温度控制能耗的建筑规范。利用萨克拉门托158,112户住宅的逐时用电数据，我们估计，1978年后不久建成的住宅，其制冷用电量比1978年前建成的类似住宅低8%至13%。将估计的节能收益与该政策的预计成本相比较，我们的结果表明，该政策通过了成本效益检验。在市场失灵导致能源成本无法完全传导至房价的情形下，建筑规范可以成为提高能源效率的一种具有成本效益的工具。

title: Climate Policy Transition Risk and the Macroeconomy
abstract: Uncertainty surrounding if the U.S. will implement a federal climate policy introduces risk into the decision to invest in long-lived capital assets, particularly those designed to use, or to replace fossil fuel.  We develop a dynamic, general equilibrium model to quantify the macroeconomic impacts of this climate policy transition risk. The model incorporates beliefs over the likelihood that the government adopts a climate policy causing the economy to dynamically transition to a lower carbon economy. We find that climate policy transition risk decreases carbon emissions today by causing investment to fall and become relatively cleaner. This emissions reduction however, represents only a small fraction of the reduction that would be achieved by adopting the carbon price, and it comes at a much higher cost.
abstract_zh: 美国是否会实施联邦气候政策存在不确定性，这给长期资本资产的投资决策带来了风险，尤其是那些用于使用或替代化石燃料的资产。我们建立了一个动态一般均衡模型，用以量化这种气候政策转型风险的宏观经济影响。该模型纳入了关于政府采取气候政策可能性的信念，这一政策将促使经济动态地转向低碳经济。我们发现，气候政策转型风险通过抑制投资并使投资转向相对更清洁的方向，从而降低了当前的碳排放。然而，这种减排只占采用碳价格所能实现减排量的一小部分，且代价要高得多。

title: Hourly accounting of carbon emissions from the electricity sector
Uncertainty and Additionality in Energy Efficiency Programs
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Emissions, Transmission, and the Environmental Value of Renewable Energy
abstract: We examine how transmission congestion alters the environmental benefits provided by renewable generation. Using hourly data from the Texas and midcontinent electricity markets, we find that relaxing transmission constraints between the wind-rich areas and the demand centers of the respective markets conservatively increases the nonmarket value of wind by 30 percent for Texas and 17 percent for midcontinent markets. Much of this increase in the nonmarket value arises from a redistribution in where air quality improvements occur—when transmission is not constrained, wind offsets much more pollution from fossil fuel units located near highly populated demand centers. (JEL L94, Q42, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 本文考察输电阻塞如何改变可再生能源发电所带来的环境效益。利用得克萨斯州和中部大陆（Midcontinent）电力市场的逐时数据，我们发现，放宽风能丰富地区与各市场负荷中心之间的输电约束，可保守地使风电的非市场价值在得克萨斯州提高30%，在中部大陆市场提高17%。非市场价值增长的很大一部分源于空气质量改善发生地点的重新分布：当输电不受约束时，风电能够抵消更多位于人口密集负荷中心附近的化石燃料机组所排放的污染。（JEL L94, Q42, Q51, Q53）

title: Setting with the Sun: The impacts of renewable energy on conventional generation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Policies supporting investment in renewable electricity have been a cornerstone of climate policy in many parts of the world. While previous empirical work explores the economic and environmental impacts of renewable production, the focus has been on the short-run impacts of expanding renewable supply. In this paper, we shed light on the potential longer-run impacts of renewable expansions. Focusing on California’s electricity market, we estimate how wholesale electricity prices have responded to a dramatic increase in utility-scale solar capacity. While an overall decline in daily average prices can be attributed to the solar expansion, this reduction in the average price masks a substantial decrease in midday prices combined with an increase in shoulder hour prices. These results imply that short-term power markets are responding to the renewable expansion in a fashion that could sustain more flexible conventional generation, while undermining the economic viability of traditional baseload generation technologies.
abstract_zh: 支持可再生电力投资的政策，已成为世界许多地区气候政策的基石。尽管以往的实证研究探讨了可再生能源生产的经济和环境影响，但其关注点一直在于扩大可再生能源供给的短期影响。本文揭示了可再生能源扩张可能产生的长期影响。以加利福尼亚州电力市场为研究对象，我们估计了批发电价对公用事业规模太阳能装机容量急剧增长的反应。日均电价整体下降可归因于太阳能扩张，但这一平均价格的下降掩盖了一个重要事实：午间电价大幅下跌，与此同时，肩时段电价却有所上升。这些结果表明，短期电力市场对可再生能源扩张的反应，可能支撑更具灵活性的常规发电，同时却削弱了传统基荷发电技术的经济可行性。

title: The Cost of Charging Plug-in Electric Vehicles (PEVs): Within Day Variation in Emissions and Electricity Prices
The Distributional Effects of a Carbon Tax on Current and Future Generations
abstract: This paper examines the non-environmental welfare effects of introducing a revenue- neutral carbon tax policy. Using a life cycle model, we find that the welfare effects of the policy differ substantially for agents who are alive when the policy is enacted compared to those who are born into the new steady state with the carbon tax in place. Consistent with previous studies, we demonstrate that, for those born in the new steady state, the welfare costs are always lower when the carbon tax revenue is used to reduce an existing distortionary tax as opposed to being returned in the form of lump-sum payments. In contrast, during the transition, we find that rebating the revenue with a lump sum transfer is less costly than using the revenue to reduce the distortionary labor tax. Additionally, we find that the tax policy is substantially more regressive over the transition than in the steady state, regardless of what is done with the revenue. Overall, our results demonstrate that estimates of the non-environmental welfare costs of carbon tax policies that are based solely on the long-run, steady state outcomes may ultimately paint too rosy of a picture. Thus, when designing climate policies, policymakers must pay careful attention to not only the long-run outcomes, but also the transitional welfare costs and regressivity of the policy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了引入收入中性碳税政策所产生的非环境福利效应。利用生命周期模型，我们发现，该政策的福利效应在政策实施时已存活的人群与出生于开征碳税后新稳态中的人群之间存在显著差异。与以往研究一致，我们证明，对于出生于新稳态中的人群而言，若将碳税收入用于削减现有扭曲性税收，福利成本总是低于以一次性总额转移支付的方式返还收入。相反，在转型期间，我们发现以一次性转移支付返还收入的成本低于用收入削减扭曲性劳动税的成本。此外，我们发现，无论收入如何使用，该税收政策在转型期内的累退性都显著强于稳态。总之，我们的结果表明，仅基于长期稳态结果估算碳税政策非环境福利成本，最终可能描绘出过于乐观的图景。因此，在设计气候政策时，政策制定者不仅须关注长期结果，还须仔细考虑政策的转型期福利成本与累退性。

title: The Incentive to Overinvest in Energy Efficiency: Evidence from Hourly Smart-Meter Data
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Many households pay a marginal price for electricity that exceeds the marginal social cost of supplying that electricity. We show evidence that such pricing schemes can create an incentive to overinvest in energy efficiency. Using hourly smart-meter data for households facing time-invariant increasing block prices, we estimate how air conditioner upgrades affect electricity use. We find that the average participating household reduces consumption by 5%, which provides private savings in the form of lower electricity bills and social cost savings by decreasing generation and pollution costs. The private savings exceed the social savings by an average of 140%, so the average household is faced with an incentive to overinvest in energy efficiency. This incentive to overinvest in energy efficiency would be cut in half if consumers faced any one of three alternative pricing plans with lower marginal price but the same average price.
abstract_zh: 许多家庭支付的电力边际价格超过了供电的边际社会成本。我们提供证据表明，此类定价方案可能激励过度投资于能源效率。利用面对时间不变的递增阶梯电价的家庭小时级智能电表数据，我们估计了空调升级对用电量的影响。我们发现，参与升级的家庭平均减少了5%的用电量，这既带来了电费降低形式的私人节省，也通过减少发电和污染成本带来了社会成本节约。私人节省平均比社会节省高出140%，因此，平均而言，家庭面临过度投资于能源效率的激励。如果消费者面对的是边际价格较低但平均价格相同的三种替代定价方案中的任意一种，这种过度投资的激励将减半。

title: Overlapping Environmental Policies and the Impact on Pollution
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper examines how increases in renewable generation interact with market-based environmental regulations to affect the emissions of both regulated and unregulated pollutants. Using a simple analytical model, I first demonstrate that, when combined with a cap-and-trade program, expansions in renewable generation have the potential to cause an undesirable outcome—they can increase emissions of unregulated pollutants. To explore whether this unintended increase in unregulated pollution could occur in practice, I look back at a NOX cap-and-trade program that was in place in the eastern United States from 2009 through 2014—the EPA’s Clean Air Interstate Rule. Using hourly generation and emissions data, I estimate how unregulated emissions of CO2 and SO2 would have been affected by adding new wind turbines and solar panels in the presence of a binding cap on NOX. I show that, once the interaction with the NOX cap is taken into consideration, renewable capacity additions would have offset much less CO2 than was previously thought. Moreover, I find that the renewable additions would have increased SO2 emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了可再生能源发电量的增加如何与基于市场的环境规制相互作用，进而影响受规制和未受规制污染物的排放。我首先利用一个简单的分析模型证明，当可再生能源扩张与总量控制与交易计划相结合时，可能导致一个不理想的结果：未受规制污染物的排放反而增加。为探究这种未受规制污染的意外增加在现实中是否确实发生，我考察了2009年至2014年间美国东部实施的一项氮氧化物（NOX）总量控制与交易计划，即美国环保署的《清洁空气州际规则》（Clean Air Interstate Rule）。利用逐时发电和排放数据，我估计了在氮氧化物存在具有约束力的总量上限的情况下，新增风力发电机和太阳能板将如何影响二氧化碳（CO2）和二氧化硫（SO2）等未受规制污染物的排放。研究表明，一旦考虑到与氮氧化物总量上限的相互作用，可再生能源装机容量的增加所减少的二氧化碳排放，将远低于此前的认识。此外，我发现，可再生能源的增加本会导致二氧化硫排放上升。

title: Review of the Economics Literature on U.S. Electricity Restructuring
Upgrading Efficiency and Behavior: Electricity Savings from Residential Weatherization Programs
abstract: Residential weatherization programs have become a major component of U.S. energy policy. Through these programs, households receive heavily subsidized energy efficiency upgrades as well as informational and behavioral treatments designed to encourage conservation. While previous work demonstrates that weatherization programs provide sizable energy savings, all have measured the composite effect of efficiency upgrades and behavioral treatments. In this paper, we present the first estimates which disentangle the energy savings provided by each of the individual interventions. Our results reveal that the actual energy savings achieved by the efficiency upgrades are substantially smaller than ex-ante, engineering predictions. Moreover, we present evidence that the energy savings provided by the simple behavioral interventions can exceed the savings resulting from the much more costly efficiency upgrades.
abstract_zh: 住宅保温改造项目已成为美国能源政策的重要组成部分。通过这些项目，家庭可获得大幅补贴的能源效率升级，以及旨在鼓励节约用能的信息和行为干预。尽管以往研究表明，保温改造项目能带来可观的节能效果，但所有研究衡量的都是效率升级与行为干预的综合效应。本文首次估计了各项干预措施各自所带来的节能效果。我们的结果显示，效率升级实际实现的节能量大大低于事前的工程预测。此外，我们提供的证据表明，简单的行为干预所带来的节能效果可以超过成本高得多的效率升级。

title: Valuing the Wind: Renewable Energy Policies and Air Pollution Avoided
abstract: Exploiting variation in the hourly production from wind turbines, this paper quantifies the heterogeneity in the marginal impact of renewable electricity on pollution. The results reveal that output from competing renewable capacity additions—e.g., wind turbines versus solar panels—provide different marginal external benefits. This finding suggests that, if governments continue to subsidize renewables, an emphasis should be placed on designing policies that internalize the heterogeneous benefits. More generally, my results highlight that, by incorrectly assuming renewable electricity is a homogenous good, we will understate the relative efficiency of the first-best pollution prices. (JEL L94, L98, Q42, Q48, Q51, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 利用风力发电机逐时发电量的变化，本文量化了可再生电力对污染的边际影响的异质性。结果显示，相互竞争的可再生能源装机增量（例如风力发电机与太阳能板）产生的边际外部效益各不相同。这一发现表明，若政府继续补贴可再生能源，则应着重设计能够将这些异质性效益内部化的政策。更一般地，我的结果强调，若错误地假设可再生电力是同质商品，我们将低估最优污染价格的相对效率。（JEL L94, L98, Q42, Q48, Q51, Q53, Q58）

title: Gasoline Taxes and Revenue Volatility: An Application to California
The Private and Social Economics of Bulk Electricity Storage
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
